I made the headline on the FB event cover bigger: **STOPKY / NELŽOU** went from 112 px to 136 px, about 20% larger.

- **Where:** the main cover (version A). The safe-zone check artboard draws the same cover, so it shows the new size too. I left versions B (date first) and C (yellow) alone; tell me if you want them changed as well.
- **Fit:** there was about 140 px of empty space above the yellow divider. Working from the code, the bigger headline uses about 50 px of it. The headline also still sits inside the mobile crop area.
- **Not confirmed by eye:** I took screenshots of both artboards, but they came out as tiny thumbnails. I can see the headline got bigger, but I couldn't check the spacing up close. Take a quick look in the studio.
- **Canvas check:** it fails on one problem that was already there before my change. On line 1267, an artboard's id is written as an expression instead of a plain name. I didn't touch it.
